validation.notes: OFFICIALITY OF THE DOMAIN PROVEN INDEPENDENTLY, not merely assumed from the shard: (a) Campus France South Africa, an agency of the French Ministries of Europe and Foreign Affairs and of Higher Education, states 'As a means to facilitate access to information for potential candidates, and to streamline the application process, we have created a dedicated website: https://www.southafrica-france-scholarships.com' (southafrica.campusfrance.org/apply-now-for-a-scholarship); (b) the French diplomatic mission site za.diplomatie.gouv.fr links to it as 'Accéder au site du programme de bourses franco-sud-africain'; (c) the South African government catalogue internationalscholarships.dhet.gov.za lists 'France-South Africa Scholarship Programme website' pointing at this domain. IDENTITY: the site carries NO programme-specific logo - I checked /, /rulebook, /faq, /contact-us, /register, /choose-france and every image reference is either the two-flag graphic, the hero banner, or a partner logo. The asset proposed here is the 'FRANCE EXCELLENCE' mark (943x647 PNG), the official French State scholarship-scheme brand, which the programme portal displays prominently on the home and application pages. Identity is supported because the shard's own official_source is 'Embassy of France in South Africa (France Excellence Scholarship)' and the programme rulebook states laureates receive 'France Excellence scholarship holder status'. CAVEAT, hence MEDIUM not HIGH: France Excellence is the umbrella scheme mark shared by several French government scholarship schemes, not a lockup unique to the France-South Africa programme. If the integrator requires a programme-exclusive mark, this record has no qualifying official logo and should be downgraded to not_found.
